name: hydro-dmrv
description: Carbon-credit dMRV for grid-connected hydropower under Verra VMR0017 v1.0 (ACM0002 v22.0). A 5-stage engine and the DmrvRegistry VMR0017 module share one integer set for ER = BE − PE − LE. Raw readings and reports go to HCS so anyone can reproduce a mint. A mint needs the meter and a VVB signature (EIP-712). The registry creates HTS credits (1 token = 1 t CO2e) and NFT retirement certificates. CreditMarket settles only when Chainlink and Supra agree and the SaucerSwap WHBAR/USDC pool is within 3% on-chain. A sale with no pool reverts. Ships an MCP server so agents can assess designs, verify, reproduce and prepare purchases with their own wallets.

steps.text: Hydro dMRV composes HCS (raw readings + reports), HTS (credit token and NFT certificates created by the contract), Chainlink + Supra (USD-priced settlement) and a SaucerSwap reserve check around a VMR0017 engine. README.md is the human brief; AGENTS.md is the only agent policy.
